newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Trade in J. Matins halted for rights.
newsitem.headline: Trade in J. Matins halted for rights.

text.p: Share trade in retailer Jeronimo Martins will be halted between November 26 and 29 for the exercising of the rights to the capital call, the Lisbon bourse said in a statement.
Jeronimo Martins & Filho SGPS is doubling capital to 27.4 billion escudos, with a third of the increase being made via a bonus issue and the remainder priced at 1,000 per share.
The shares closed at 14,270 escudos on Monday. The aim of the capital move is to boost share trade liquidity.
